SKULLPANDA at Doja Cat’s 31st Birthday Party

International superstar Doja Cat will be hosting her plushie-themed 31st birthday party with a star-studded guest list. To bring the plushie theme to life, Doja Cat chose SKULLPANDA, one of her favorite IP characters, for the decor, cake design, and guest gifts.

Brief

Hook (opening line)：Open with something high-energy that fits a birthday celebration, for example: “Happy birthday, Doja! Look who showed up to the party...”

About SKULLPANDA:

SKULLPANDA was created by Chinese artist XiongMiao and is celebrating its 8th anniversary this year
For her birthday, Doja Cat decorated and gifted guests some of her favorite SKULLPANDA dolls, including the My Little Pony series, My Melody series, and the new Off Mode series

Required hashtags and tags：

Include #skullpanda in every post.

Tag @popmart_us in every post.
